items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yes, he's my baby brother, and that's all I got now.

ctx.x: Do you know how you mother and father met?
Let me think. No, I've heard them talk about such things, though, so many times. But really... Von, do you know how Mama and Papa met? Did you ever hear them say?
It was always a secret, I think. (laughter)
